02 / A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Part problem solver.
Part possibility seeker.

I like the space where thoughtful design meets useful technology. This is where I collect the things I build, the ideas I explore, and the lessons I pick up along the way.

For me, the best part of making something is connecting the dots — taking a tricky problem and turning it into an experience that just feels right.
